review_response_tasks.stem: My aunt's job is writing stories. She is a ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：visitor表示访客，不是写故事这一职业名称。；B：writer是以写作为工作的人，正合题面。；C：driver表示驾驶员，不是所定义的工作。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our meal plan says: “Lunch 12:15.” At 12:15, we have ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：按本题给定计划该时刻为午餐，不推论所有家庭。；B：题面该时刻安排的不是早餐。；C：题面安排的不是晚餐。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our library rule says “Keep the books clean.” We must not ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：借书本身不违反保持书本干净的规则。；B：仔细阅读不违反该规则。；C：在书上画画违反明确给出的保持书本干净规则。

review_response_tasks.stem: For the class play, Sam must wear a red coat. He needs the ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：颜色不符明确的red要求。；B：颜色和衣物类别同时符合。；C：颜色虽对，但hat不是指定的coat。

review_response_tasks.stem: Box A has no books; box B is filled with books. A is ____, but B is ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：A没有书为空，B装满书为满，两项均合。；B：把两箱的状态反过来了。；C：第二项与B装满书冲突。

review_response_tasks.stem: This paper shows my film name and seat number at the cinema. It is my ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：护照不是显示电影和影院座位的入场凭证。；B：地图不是指定影片座位的凭证。；C：影院票含影片及座位信息，符合描述。

review_response_tasks.stem: I put these two sheets together with a sticky liquid called ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：string是线，不是黏性液体。；B：glue为黏合纸张的胶，符合液体及黏合功能。；C：scissors是剪切工具，不是黏性液体。

review_response_tasks.stem: Last night the children ____ a shadow play.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：Last night明确过去时间，saw为see的过去式。；B：原形see不合本句明确的过去时间。；C：句中缺少助动词，不能单用seeing作谓语。

review_response_tasks.stem: At Book Day, we give a book and keep a different one, without paying. We ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：明确without paying，不是购买。；B：题面是互换并保留不同的书，不是归还借书。；C：互相给出并保留不同的书，符合swap交换。

review_response_tasks.stem: The toy instructions say “Push with the back legs.” We push with its ____ legs.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：与给定说明back相反。；B：直接符合这件玩具的说明，不泛化真实动物。；C：题面指定后腿，不是四条腿都推。
